fields.name: MapToSql*Attribute target-type matrix
fields.description: The target SQL Server type (the SqlDbType each variant's constructor passes to SqlParameterMapAttribute) and the CLR property shapes its IsValidType override accepts, for the 23 MapToSql*Attribute variants. Nullable forms are accepted only where listed; enum acceptance is limited to the string-family and integer variants. Every accepted shape works through input parameters, output parameters, data-reader reads and table-valued-parameter rows; any other shape is rejected with InvalidMapTypeException when the mapping is first built.

members.name: NVarChar
members.description: string, enum, nullable enum; length -1 selects nvarchar(max)

members.name: VarChar
members.description: string, enum, nullable enum; length -1 selects varchar(max), and localeId

members.name: Char
members.description: string, enum, nullable enum; length and localeId

members.name: BigInt
members.description: long, enum, nullable long (Nullable<long>); a nullable enum is NOT accepted

members.name: Int
members.description: int, enum, nullable int (Nullable<int>), nullable enum

members.name: SmallInt
members.description: short, enum, nullable short (Nullable<short>), nullable enum

members.name: TinyInt
members.description: byte, enum, nullable byte (Nullable<byte>), nullable enum

members.name: Decimal
members.description: decimal or nullable decimal; precision and scale

members.name: Date
members.description: DateOnly or nullable DateOnly (DateTime is NOT accepted); a date output parameter returned as DateTime is read back as its DateOnly date part

members.name: Time
members.description: TimeSpan, TimeOnly, nullable TimeSpan, or nullable TimeOnly; a TimeOnly value is sent (input parameter and table-valued-parameter row) as its TimeSpan equivalent and read back from the TimeSpan or TimeOnly value the provider returns

members.name: VarBinary
members.description: byte[] only (no nullable wrapper; ReadOnlySpan<byte>, Span<byte>, ReadOnlyMemory<byte> and Memory<byte> are rejected); length -1 selects varbinary(max)

representations.C#: Each member is realized by a MapToSql<member>Attribute subclass.
